rationale: Two full pilot variants retained. Select by model using all pilot seeds; no per-seed version selection. Validation results are not used to tune parameters.
provenance: SingleBatchDescent derives from the workspace CycleDescent design, including concurrent per-site cache work, with a dedicated B=1 module, delivery-only exchange and removal of pickup-only proposals for pure delivery.
validation_gate: Initial descent failed broad validation, especially M3; it is retained as a rejected candidate.
followup_candidate: No parameter sweep: defer descent until the last 20% of either budget; retain M4 unchanged. Previously reserved cases now become development/recheck for this variant; source 100-5-3 was newly reserved before results.
recheck_completed: Tail policy mean paired distance changes: M1 -1.1096%, M2 -1.7288%, M3 -0.7003%; all 27 feasible. Tail policy retained uniformly for M1-M3 before viewing new-source results.
adopted_source_note: Same tail algorithm; adds only descriptive descent_budget_policy result metadata. Fixed-iteration source equality checked after performance runs.
final_decision: Adopt tail polishing for M1-M3; M2 novel-source average is effectively flat, so no stable M2 quality-gain claim. Preserve M4. All 45 final candidate runs audited; full regression and frozen/live equality passed.
